heading: About the Application
description: A full-stack application for monitoring agricultural fields with the Normalized Difference Vegetation Index (NDVI) computed from Sentinel-2 satellite imagery. The system combines Finnish open field parcel data, weather data and a serverless AWS backend to give a fast, low-cost overview of the growing season.

featureGroups.title: NDVI & Satellite Data
items: Sentinel-2 imagery via Copernicus Data Space Ecosystem (CDSE)
NDVI statistics and 9-class colour-coded NDVI images
NDVI timeline and year-to-year comparison charts

featureGroups.title: Fields & Crop Parcels
items: Field selection from map, municipality search or GeoJSON upload
Crop parcel history 2020–2025 (Finnish Food Authority open data)

featureGroups.title: Architecture
items: AWS Lambda, API Gateway and Step Functions
MongoDB Atlas and Azure Cosmos DB for MongoDB
